plan.archetype: Efficient attacks into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Secure efficient damage, reliable poison, upgraded defense, and a defensive potion. Preserve enough HP and block for the explosion after killing the body.
plan.summary: Add early damage before pursuing scaling. Build poison alongside dexterity and efficient block. Remove the new curse first, then Strikes. Fight elites only with adequate damage, HP, and potions.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with efficient defense and dexterity
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade poison and defensive engines, secure a defensive potion, and enter healthy. Killing the body still requires surviving its explosion.
plan.summary: Take the immediate rest route and bypass the elite. Heal while critically injured, then upgrade core poison and defense when safe. Seek scaling and dexterity rather than more costly attacks.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling supported by dexterity and efficient defense
plan.bossPrep: Heal now. Establish poison and Accelerants while blocking attacks. Use potions to shorten the fight; preserve health and prepare block for the post-kill explosion.
plan.summary: Existing poison supplies scaling; prioritize defense, dexterity, and draw instead of more damage cards. Remove Injury and Strikes. Upgrade core powers when healthy, and avoid elites until defensive consistency improves.
